blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Four individuals were arrested during an anti-illegal gambling operation in Barangay Resurreccion, San Juan town in this province on Tuesday, Oct. 6, police said. The San Juan Municipal Police Station said the four were caught playing “Pining-Pining,” an illegal card game, with bet money. Police said the operation was carried out after they received information from a concerned citizen about an alleged illegal gambling activity in the village. Recovered from the suspects were a set of red playing cards, bet money, a steel table, a brown towel and four monoblock chairs, police said. READ: 6 nabbed […]...
